image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Fourth Quarter, Fiscal 2025
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended March 31, 2025, and the year ended March 31, 2025, compared to the same periods in the previous year. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, with year-over-year growth percentages provided. For the quarter, revenues increased by 3.6% to $4,730 million, while net profit after minority interest decreased by 15.2% to $813 million. The operating margin remained stable at 21.0%. For the year, revenues rose by 3.9% to $19,277 million, with a slight decrease in net profit after minority interest by 0.2% to $3,162 million. The data highlights trends in revenue growth and profitability, indicating a mixed performance across the fiscal year.
